title: Wire same-lane Completer flavors without forking the library
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore’s product needs a deep code Completer beside the default reason Completer in one Config. He registers a second Named flavor and a small host harness that selects it with Annotated Matched tags — no marker-lane ABCs and no edits to MechaHarness enums.
implementation:
`MechaHarnessConfig.completer_bindings()` registers `Named` Completer tag sets (lane + host flavors). Host constructors declare `Annotated[Completer, Named(...)]` / `Matched(...)`. `CliInstrumentor` verb `check_completer_flavors` exercises the blessed DI path. Bare `inject(Completer)` keeps the default aliased to `InferenceStrategy`.

Covers: same-lane Completer flavors via pyiv Named/Matched.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
